string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Addons: new “Add an addon” row (in Addons and in Settings › Addons) with a code for your phone, which opens the panel ready to paste the address, or to type it on the TV
Addons: “Recommended” list with checked catalogs (movies and shows from the services, TMDB, MUBI and anime); pick one and confirm with the PIN, no typing
Addons: a catalog title with no video to play here shows “Where to watch”, which opens the Google TV search
Alarm clock: on the time wheel the bigger number is on top, and the lists no longer show the options underneath
Alarm clock: holding the arrow turns the wheel slowly (4 steps per second), so you can stop at the right time

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: In Addons, does the “Add an addon” row show the code, and when scanned on the phone does the panel open at the Addons card?
In Addons › Recommended, does picking “The Movie Database” and confirming with the PIN install it, and do its catalogs show and open?
In the alarm clock, does holding ▲ raise the hour slowly and stop where you let go?
